entries.title: Mega menu — columns
entries.summary: Use a column-based mega menu for a top-level navigation item, with optional product promotions.
entries.keywords: mega navigation columns promotions menu block Choose the top-level menu item to enhance. Set the number of menu columns. Add up to two optional promotional products with descriptions. Control promotional image ratio, image corner radius, and whether promotion prices are shown.

entries.title: Mega menu — visual grid
entries.summary: Present submenu links as visual cards and control how images appear.
entries.keywords: mega grid cards images navigation child item The visual grid displays child navigation items as visual cards. You can control the desktop columns, frame style, media area size, image spacing, fit, scale, and corner radius. Up to eight custom images can be supplied; when possible, the theme can use imagery associated with linked products or collections.

entries.title: Compact dropdown
entries.summary: Choose a compact navigation dropdown when a full mega menu is unnecessary.
entries.keywords: menu dropdown width narrow medium wide Use Compact dropdown when a top-level item needs a simple menu rather than a large mega menu. The block lets you select a narrow, medium, or wide dropdown width.

entries.title: Header predictive search
entries.summary: Configure the search experience offered from the storefront header.
entries.keywords: predictive search search suggestions header placeholder When search is enabled in the Header, ADLAC can render predictive search suggestions. The rotating placeholder labels are configured in the Header section.

entries.title: Product media gallery
entries.summary: Set up product gallery media, including Shopify images and supported video or 3D media.
entries.keywords: product gallery images videos model 3d thumbnails desktop The Main product media gallery supports product images, Shopify-hosted video, external video, and 3D models. Merchants can configure media width, media ratio, media fit, image spacing, desktop thumbnails, and the media counter.

entries.title: Product information tabs
entries.summary: Place descriptions, technical specifications and compatible app content in product tabs.
entries.keywords: tabs description specifications reviews custom liquid app blocks Add a Product information tabs block, then add one or more Information tab children. A tab can contain Product description, Product specifications, Custom Liquid, or compatible app blocks. Tab labels can be set to Description, Technical specifications, Reviews, or Custom. Reviews can optionally show a rating summary when the installed review app maintains Shopify's standard product rating metafields.

entries.title: Gift card recipient fields
entries.summary: Understand the gift card recipient experience exposed by compatible product purchase controls.
entries.keywords: gift card recipient gift cards buy buttons email Gift card products can show the recipient form inside Buy buttons. The customer can provide a recipient email, optional name and message, and an optional send date. Accelerated checkout is not rendered for gift card products in this block.

entries.title: Product recommendations
entries.summary: Use the related-product experience documented for the ADLAC product template.
entries.keywords: recommended products related products complementary The default product template includes separate complementary and related Product recommendations sections. Their product cards can show secondary images, swatches, Quick Buy, and configurable image presentation.

entries.title: Product cards & swatches
entries.summary: Control collection product cards, including applicable swatch and quick-add choices.
entries.keywords: color swatches quick add cards collection images Collection product cards can show Quick Buy, color swatches, a secondary image on hover, and configurable media ratio/presentation/spacing/fit. Swatches preview matching variant images on pointer hover or keyboard focus. The preview is temporary; the original card image returns when the interaction ends.

entries.title: Collection filtering & sorting
entries.summary: Configure the filtering and sorting experience on collection pages.
entries.keywords: filter sorting facets search discovery collection The collection template renders Shopify-native storefront filters, active filter chips, price ranges, sorting, a desktop filter form, and a mobile filter drawer. Available filters come from the store's Shopify filter configuration.

entries.title: Cart drawer
entries.summary: Understand the ADLAC cart drawer experience for AJAX cart changes.
entries.keywords: ajax add to cart cart drawer discounts quantity The cart drawer is rendered globally and can show a cart note. It supports line-item updates and is refreshed by the theme's AJAX cart behavior after eligible add-to-cart actions.

entries.title: Footer newsletter
entries.summary: Configure the newsletter signup control in the footer.
entries.keywords: email signup footer newsletter form The newsletter uses Shopify's customer form and tags submitted contacts as newsletter . Success and error messages are rendered by the theme.

entries.title: Country & language selectors
entries.summary: Make language and country choices available where configured and supported by Shopify Markets.
entries.keywords: locale localization countries languages markets currency When more than one language or country is available, the footer renders language and country/currency selectors using Shopify's localization form. Country changes preserve the current storefront path while allowing Shopify to apply the selected market context.

entries.title: Reviews in product tabs
entries.summary: Place an app-powered review experience inside ADLAC product information tabs.
entries.keywords: reviews app block rating metafields tab widget Install your review app Install a Shopify review app that provides a theme app block for product reviews. Open the product template In the theme editor, open the default product template and select Main product → Product information tabs . Open or add the Reviews tab Select an Information tab and set Tab label to Reviews . Add the app block Inside that tab, choose Add block → Apps and select the review app's product review block.

entries.title: Variant picker & swatches
entries.summary: Understand the product variant picker and its supported swatch handling.
entries.keywords: variant picker shopify swatches option values color size linked product Variant picker Uses Shopify option values, supports Shopify swatches, unavailable states, and linked-product option URLs.
